PHPMailer — vendored dependency
================================

Source:  https://github.com/PHPMailer/PHPMailer
Version: 7.1.1 (src/PHPMailer.php, src/SMTP.php, src/Exception.php only —
         no autoloader, no Composer; required by hand from
         includes/mailer.php, matching this project's existing vendor/fpdf
         pattern)
License: GNU Lesser General Public License v2.1 (LGPL-2.1)
         https://www.gnu.org/licenses/old-licenses/lgpl-2.1.html

Each vendored file carries its own original PHPMailer license header.
No modifications were made to the vendored source files themselves.
